notes: Fastned's published charge curve for the Toyota bZ4X "75 kWh (2022-2025)" (read from the page's embedded chart data, one value per % SoC; every 5 % kept plus the peak). Fastned states curves show the car with the battery in optimal condition (about 30 °C) on its 300 kW-class chargers; cold or hot batteries charge slower. European market car. Fastned labels the pack 75 kWh (marketing size); the 150 kW rating and 147 kW peak match the 71.4 kWh, 150 kW FWD hardware (generation A). Starts at 9 % SoC in the source. The shape (peak about 147 kW at 25 %, 90 kW at 50 %, 39 kW at 80 %) is a 400 V NMC taper. Cars.com measured a much weaker 52 kW peak at Electrify America with a US FWD XLE (cold/unknown conditions; single test), so US winter results can be far lower. Model year not stated by Fastned; European car; spans the 2023 launch and 2024-25 charging-update generations. Contrast: Cars.com cold test of a US 2023 FWD XLE never exceeded 52 kW.
